sections.title: Overview
sections.contentMarkdown:
Purpose: Provide a concise overview of the system, scope, and design decisions.

Scope: Covers API surface, data model, architecture, scaling considerations and security notes.

sections.title: Metadata
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Owner:** @platform-team
**Status:** Planned
**Priority:** High
**Reviewers:** @infra, @security
**Created:** 2026-05-01

sections.title: Architecture
sections.contentMarkdown: High-level architecture: Frontend → API Gateway → Services → Redis / Primary DB. Include a diagram and callouts for critical components.

sections.title: Architecture Diagram
sections.contentMarkdown: ![Architecture diagram](https://picsum.photos/seed/technical-arch/1200/360)

sections.title: System Flow
sections.contentMarkdown:
Frontend -> API Gateway -> Auth Service -> Canvas Service -> Redis (pub/sub) -> Primary DB

Notes: Use horizontal scaling for stateless services and Redis for realtime fan-out.

sections.title: API Endpoints
sections.contentMarkdown:
- `POST /api/canvas/create` — Create a new canvas (returns canvas id)
- `GET /api/templates` — List production templates
- `PATCH /api/canvas/:id` — Patch canvas content (optimistic patch)
- `GET /api/canvas/:id` — Fetch canvas with metadata

sections.title: Database Schema
sections.contentMarkdown:
```sql
CREATE TABLE canvases (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id UUID NOT NULL,
  channel_id UUID NULL,
  created_by UUID NOT NULL,
  permissions JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  content JSONB NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_canvases_workspace ON canvases(workspace_id);
```

sections.title: Components
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Editor Service (Web, client integration)
- Collaboration Service (Yjs + WebSocket)
- API Gateway (auth, rate limiting)
- Storage (Primary DB, S3 for attachments)
- Redis (pub/sub and caching)

sections.title: Risks & Mitigations
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Risk:** Redis scaling limits may cause delayed fan-out.
**Mitigation:** Shard channels, add backpressure and fallbacks to polling.

**Risk:** Large canvas payloads cause slow writes.
**Mitigation:** Store deltas and snapshots, avoid full payload writes on every edit.

sections.title: Timeline & Milestones
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Milestone 1 — Design (2 weeks)
- Milestone 2 — Implementation (6 weeks)
- Milestone 3 — Beta & Monitoring (2 weeks)

sections.title: Notes
sections.contentMarkdown:
Security: All write endpoints are rate limited and require auth tokens. Use signed URLs for large uploads.

Observability: Export traces for canvas edits and instrument pub/sub latency.
